{{Quote|The sky was full of them as they descended upon us. I wondered if our men on the ground would think us brave fools, or just fools.|Eyewitness report of Lieutenant Blair|<ref name="TIE" />}}
A '''resistance group''' fought in the [[Battle of Slotern]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="TIE" /> before or during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'']] comic places the events of ''The Force Unleashed II'' in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the databank have to happen by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Part of the resistance group on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Slotern]] used starfighters to battle against the Imperial [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]], while another part of the group was on the ground. Every member of the group that participated in the battle [[Death/Legends|died]] with the exception of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Blair]], who managed to survive the aerial assault.<ref name="TIE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The resistance group was first mentioned in the "TIE fighter" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="TIE" />
